data.sub: Amitabh Bachchan ke ghar par firing ki saazish ke 2 shooter arrest.
data.asar: Khabar serious hai, isliye is par koi mazaak nahi.
data.caption:
Badi khabar saamne aayi hai.

• 2 shooters arrest kiye gaye
• Firing ki saazish ka maamla
• Amitabh Bachchan ki cryptic post

Aise mamlo mein satark rehna zaroori hai.

Apne kisi dost ko tag karo jo Bollywood news mein update rehta hai.
